notes: OPENING LORE: PC is daughter in a crime dynasty. Two federal agents interrogate her, make her 'prove herself' in Kickback Keys (city name generated/default). Police crackdown 3 months prior fractured gangs — 'free real estate'. Police chief is corrupt — feds' man. PC gets basement apartment.

FACTION LORE (from feds briefing): 4 gangs in Kickback Keys. (1) THE GANGS — ex-7-gangs, 3 merged. Racketeering + burglary. Control OLD DOWNTOWN (ex-city-center, now ghetto). (2) MAFIA — poseurs, stolen cars + underground fight ring, Suburbs. (3) BIKERS — couriers + weapons dealers (sell to anyone). (4) CARTEL — international trade org with local rep. DON'T MESS WITH. Feds also note: dirty_money MUST be laundered via legal enterprises (IRS).

NPC SOCIALIZE DETAIL: Bar NPC card includes icon class hint (thug_icon for 'Potential Thug'). Recruitable class categories visible as icons even without Observant trait — thug/thief/etc. likely correspond to gang strength recruits from earlier notes. Roles seen: Loader. Wealth: Low-End. Observant trait would reveal abilities + engagement status.

PROGRESS MECHANIC: observer_trait_progress ticks +7 per NPC contact added (8→15 on first add). Likely 21 or 100 threshold unlocks 'Observant' trait for hidden stat reveals. Trait progression via repeated actions is a core loop.

RANDOM ENCOUNTER: Downtown Attack — street tax gang member demands random amount (307 bucks seen) to pass. Choices: pay / fight / scream (rep loss). No-money state locks out pay option. Triggers on district entry (blocks Marketplace click).

COMBAT SYSTEM: Turn-based, action card per entity. Starting actions: Kick (2-turn CD), Slap (basic), Defense. Young Thug w/ Baseball Bat = 24hp, can stun (10dmg). Starting PC = 30hp / combat 5-6. Loss redirects to 'Downtown Lose' — flavor + refund-if-broke ('tried to rob 307$... you're broke'). Loss path goes home to recover. Combat options extend with weapons+skills (Target button suggests multi-enemy).

WHITEBOARD (confirmed full text): 7 goals (verbatim): (1) >$10k, (2) warehouse at harbor, (3) own house via PC browse, (4) meet ALL 4 factions (mafia/cartel/gangs/bikers) via district exploration OR by raising rep (they contact you), (5) 'Big Shot' rep, (6) 3x 'Block 19' handguns (bikers sell traceless), (7) gang strength >300 via recruiting thug/thief-icon NPCs from bars/nightclubs (higher combat=more strength). Completing all unlocks: 'create your gang by accessing the whiteboard'.

ECONOMY DEEP DIVE — KEY BUILDINGS: (A) CITY BANK 'The Bank': 20% commission, deposit has 0.5% daily rate, 1-withdraw-per-week (20/10/5% of deposit, or 100% if <$10k). Loans: $1000 base, 5%/day deducted from paycheck, higher rep = better loans. Rep=solvency. (B) WAREHOUSES at Harbor: rent starting at $60 min, stealing gated 'too dangerous by day' (night-only). Goal #2 = owning one. (C) PLAYER LAB: chem production 0/5 chemists, each +40% production & costs $60/day, batches reach 100% then yield output, property tax layer on top. Chemists hired 'on central streets'. (D) JUNKYARD: improvised weapons workshop buyout $50000, $170/day maintenance, locked behind 'establish a gang first'. So Junkyard-workshop is POST-gang-creation content.
